# Rule catalog

Rule sets are CEL over `f` (features, doubles) and `event` (transaction fields, enums by name). Evaluated by the Java scoring core and re-evaluated by `pulsebench verify` for parity. Precedence: DECLINE rule > ALLOW rule > score >= decline > REVIEW rule > score >= review > APPROVE.

## `baseline-ext` - version `baseline-v5-ext1`

Model thresholds: review >= `None`, decline >= `None`.

| Rule | Action | When | Reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ATO_FAILED_LOGINS_NEW_DEVICE` | CHALLENGE | `f.cust_failed_logins_1h >= 2.0 && f.cust_new_device_logins_24h >= 1.0 && f.is_cnp > 0.5` | failed logins in the last hour and a login from a new device, then a remote payment |
| `ATO_CREDENTIAL_CHANGE_NEW_DEVICE` | REVIEW | `f.cust_secs_since_credential_change < 3600.0 && f.cust_device_novel > 0.5 && f.amount_usd > 100.0` | a password, email, phone or MFA change within the hour, then a payment from a device never seen |
| `CARD_TOKEN_THEN_CNP` | REVIEW | `f.card_tokens_provisioned_30d >= 2.0 && f.is_cnp > 0.5 && f.amount_usd > 200.0` | the card was provisioned to wallets twice or more in 30 days, then a remote payment over 200 |
| `TAMPERED_DEVICE` | REVIEW | `f.dev_tampered_reports_24h >= 1.0 && f.dev_max_risk_24h >= 0.7` | the device reported an emulator or root in the last day, with a risk score of 0.7 or more |
| `DEVICE_FARM` | REVIEW | `f.dev_distinct_customers_all_24h >= 5.0` | five or more customers logged in or paid from this device in the last day |

## `baseline-flows` - version `baseline-v5-flows2`

Model thresholds: review >= `None`, decline >= `None`.

| Rule | Action | When | Reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| `APP_SCAM_PAYEE_MISMATCH` | REVIEW | `event.txn.payee_check == 'PAYEE_NO_MATCH' && event.txn.new_payee` | a new payee whose name does not match the account (payee check), and the customer went ahead |
| `APP_SCAM_COACHED` | REVIEW | `event.txn.on_call && event.txn.new_payee && event.amount_usd_minor >= 50000` | 500+ to a new payee while the customer is on a phone call |
| `ATO_REMOTE_ACCESS` | DECLINE | `event.txn.remote_access && event.txn.new_payee` | a remote-access tool is running while a new payee is paid |
| `CNP_3DS_HIGH_RISK_UNAUTHENTICATED` | REVIEW | `event.txn.acs_risk_score >= 60 && event.txn.three_ds_status != 'TDS_AUTHENTICATED'` | the 3-D Secure server scored the cardholder 60+ and the payment was not authenticated |

## `baseline-rich` - version `baseline-v5-rich1`

Model thresholds: review >= `None`, decline >= `None`.

| Rule | Action | When | Reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CARD_NOT_ACTIVE` | DECLINE | `event.card_info.status in ['CARD_STATUS_BLOCKED', 'CARD_STATUS_LOST', 'CARD_STATUS_STOLEN']` | the card is blocked, lost or stolen (the status the payment carries) |
| `ACCOUNT_AML_HOLD` | REVIEW | `'AML_HOLD' in event.account_info.flags` | the account is on an AML hold |
| `TAMPERED_DEVICE_PAYMENT` | CHALLENGE | `(event.device_info.emulator \|\| event.device_info.rooted) && f.amount_usd > 100.0` | over 100 from an emulator or a rooted device |
| `NEW_PAYEE_NAME_MISMATCH` | REVIEW | `event.payee_info.new_payee && event.payee_info.name_match == 'NO_MATCH'` | a first payment to a payee whose name does not match the account |
| `GIFT_CARD_BURST` | REVIEW | `event.items.exists(i, i.category == 'GIFT_CARD') && f.cust_gift_card_baskets_24h >= 2.0` | a second gift-card basket within a day |
| `FOREIGN_BIN_VELOCITY` | REVIEW | `f.cust_auth_attempts_sum_1h >= 4.0 \|\| f.card_foreign_bin_count_24h >= 3.0` | repeated authentication attempts, or a card used repeatedly away from its issuing country |

## `baseline-status` - version `baseline-v5-status1`

Model thresholds: review >= `None`, decline >= `None`.

| Rule | Action | When | Reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CARD_BLOCKED` | DECLINE | `f.card_blocked > 0.0` | the card is blocked, lost or stolen at the issuer (its latest status change) |
| `ACCOUNT_FROZEN` | DECLINE | `f.account_frozen > 0.0` | the account is frozen or closed |
| `ACCOUNT_AML_HOLD_STATUS` | REVIEW | `f.account_aml_hold_status > 0.0` | the account is on an AML hold (its latest status change) |
| `PAYEE_LISTED` | REVIEW | `f.payee_listed > 0.0` | the payee is on a list of confirmed mule accounts |
| `BLOCKED_CARD_DEVICE` | REVIEW | `f.card_blocked == 0.0 && f.dev_blocked_card_attempts_24h >= 2.0` | a device that tried blocked cards within a day, now paying with another card |

## `baseline-v1` - version `baseline-v1`

Model thresholds: review >= `0.55`, decline >= `0.9`.

| Rule | Action | When | Reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CARD_TESTING` | DECLINE | `f.card_small_cnp_count_10m >= 3.0` | >=3 small card-not-present authorisations on the card in 10 minutes |
| `CARD_TESTING_MERCHANT` | REVIEW | `f.merch_small_cnp_count_5m >= 25.0 && event.amount_usd_minor < 200` | merchant is receiving a burst of small CNP authorisations |
| `VELOCITY_CARD_5M` | REVIEW | `f.card_count_5m > 6.0` | more than 6 transactions on the card in 5 minutes |
| `VELOCITY_CARD_1H_DISTINCT` | REVIEW | `f.card_distinct_merchants_10m >= 5.0` | card used at 5+ distinct merchants in 10 minutes |
| `IMPOSSIBLE_TRAVEL` | DECLINE | `event.card_present && f.card_geo_speed_kmh > 900.0` | card-present transactions implying travel faster than 900 km/h |
| `MAGSTRIPE_FOREIGN` | REVIEW | `event.entry_mode == 'MAGSTRIPE' && f.is_foreign > 0.5` | magstripe fallback abroad (counterfeit indicator) |
| `CONTACTLESS_SPLIT` | REVIEW | `f.card_contactless_count_30m >= 4.0 && f.card_contactless_sum_30m > 20000.0` | repeated contactless payments just under the CVM limit |
| `ATO_NEW_DEVICE_HIGH_AMOUNT` | REVIEW | `f.cust_device_novel > 0.5 && f.amount_usd > 300.0 && f.is_cnp > 0.5` | high-value remote purchase from a device never seen for this customer |
| `ATO_NEW_DEVICE_NEW_COUNTRY` | DECLINE | `f.cust_device_novel > 0.5 && f.cust_ip_country_novel > 0.5 && f.amount_usd > 100.0` | new device and new IP country with a material amount |
| `ATM_VELOCITY` | DECLINE | `f.card_atm_count_1h >= 3.0` | 3+ ATM withdrawals on the card within an hour |
| `ATM_TERMINAL_CASHOUT` | REVIEW | `f.is_atm > 0.5 && f.term_atm_sum_1h > 500000.0` | terminal dispensed > $5,000 within an hour |
| `APP_SCAM_NEW_PAYEE` | REVIEW | `f.is_transfer > 0.5 && f.cust_payee_novel > 0.5 && f.amount_usd > 1000.0` | large transfer to a payee never paid before |
| `MULE_FAN_IN` | DECLINE | `f.is_transfer > 0.5 && f.payee_distinct_senders_24h >= 6.0` | payee received transfers from 6+ distinct senders in 24h (mule pattern) |
| `BOT_DEVICE_MANY_CARDS` | DECLINE | `f.dev_distinct_cards_1h >= 4.0` | device used with 4+ distinct cards in an hour |
| `BUST_OUT_UTILISATION` | REVIEW | `f.credit_utilisation_24h > 0.8 && f.amount_to_avg_ratio > 8.0` | credit line nearly exhausted in 24h with outsized ticket |
